parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module passes. All five files belong to one HTTP adapter for Express. Three controllers turn requests into use-case calls, one shared helper file parses request fields, and one middleware maps errors to HTTP status codes. Every controller reads body and query values through the shared helpers in request-fields.ts instead of writing its own checks. The validation rule ("required, must be a string") is written once, in requiredString and optionalString, which throw ApplicationError('validation', ...). The mapping from error kind to status code also lives in one place, in STATUS_BY_KIND in error-middleware.ts. No controller sets error status codes itself or bypasses the shared helpers. Each controller converts path parameters inline with String(req.params[...]). That repeats a simple coercion, not a rule or invariant, so it does not break cohesion.
